definitions.gloss: assertive type; go-getter; aggressive pursuer (especially in romance)
definitions.explanation: A person who is proactive and assertive, especially in romantic relationships — someone who actively pursues what they want. Coined as a metaphor from the image of a meat-eating predator. Originally used mainly for men but now applied to women as well. Popularized as slang in the late 2000s.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肉食系|にくしょくけい}だ。
{肉食系|にくしょくけい}⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: There are more and more assertive women these days.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恋愛|れんあい}→恋愛：12634_renai⟧⟦に{関|かん}して→に関して：06944_nikanshite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肉食系|にくしょくけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦アプローチ→アプローチ：10702_apuroochi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧だ。
examples.english: When it comes to romance, I'm the assertive type — I actively approach people myself.

notes:
A figurative use of ⟦{肉食|にくしょく}→肉食：13922_nikushoku⟧ (meat-eating, carnivorous) combined with ⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧ (type, category). The metaphor compares assertive, proactive people to predatory carnivores who actively hunt their prey.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉食系|にくしょくけい}⟦{男子|だんし}→男子：03425_danshi⟧: assertive man (in dating)
- {肉食系|にくしょくけい}⟦{女子|じょし}→女子：03350_joshi⟧: assertive woman (in dating)
- {肉食系|にくしょくけい}⟦キャラ→キャラ：08916_kyara⟧: the go-getter character type

CULTURAL NOTE:
The term emerged in Japanese pop culture around 2006-2008 as part of a broader classification of personality types using animal diet metaphors. It contrasts with ⟦{草食系|そうしょくけい}→草食系：27138_soushokukei⟧ (herbivore type) — a passive, unassertive person, especially in romance. The ⟦{草食系|そうしょくけい}→草食系：27138_soushokukei⟧/{肉食系|にくしょくけい} dichotomy became a major cultural talking point in Japan, reflecting changing gender dynamics and dating behavior among young people.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{草食系|そうしょくけい}→草食系：27138_soushokukei⟧: herbivore type — passive, gentle, not aggressive in pursuing romance; the opposite
- ⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧: proactive, assertive — a standard adjective without the slang/metaphorical coloring
- ⟦{肉食動物|にくしょくどうぶつ}→肉食動物：18131_nikushokudoubutsu⟧: carnivore (literal) — an actual meat-eating animal
